text:
Jamie Benn got his 1,000th point last weekend, a go-ahead goal against Buffalo, and became just the second fifth-round pick to get there, as Yardbarker noted. In a season with plenty of noise around this team, it was a night that belonged entirely to the captain.

The noise is mostly about Jason Robertson. An insider floated a Robertson for Nikita Kucherov trade, and one analyst said it was difficult to imagine him signing long-term in Dallas. Nothing has happened, but the speculation is loud, and his line with Tyler Seguin and Roope Hintz has been outchanced (48% of the expected goals). Miro Heiskanen missed five straight games before returning Tuesday, per Daily Faceoff, with Tyler Myers now out with an upper-body injury.

On the ice, the Stars are 13-6-2 and have won three straight, though the chances only half back the streak: 53% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), with the goaltending saving 3.9 goals above expected. That's the season in miniature. Dallas is a solid 52% team that has scored about six fewer goals than its chances deserve and allowed about eight fewer than its chances against. Thomas Harley and Nils Lundkvist are the pair driving it, at 56%. Our numbers make them 87% to reach the playoffs. Watch the Robertson talk, and whether Jake Oettinger keeps covering the gaps.
